environment.description: Same Go Gin application packaged as a Lambda function behind a Lambda Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType: AWS_IAM. The Lambda resource policy does NOT include a principal wildcard (*) — it specifies only the ARN of an API Gateway execution role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/apigw-invoke-role) as the allowed principal. Callers must present a valid SigV4 signature from credentials associated with that specific role. The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} for any request lacking valid IAM authorization headers. Note: the application-level JWT validation code still runs after IAM auth succeeds, providing defense-in-depth, but the IAM auth gate prevents unauthenticated internet callers from ever reaching the application code.

config.network: No public ALB, function URL is the only ingress
config.key_exposure: RSA public key not externally accessible (packaged in Lambda deployment zip only)
